items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: He made the song, If I Had My Life to Live Over. I remember we was up in New York when he made that.

ctx.x: Yeah, it took him a couple of days to make that record. That's why...
So Slim was kind of problematic in the studio. Yeah, well, I mean, you know, he... In making records.

Oh, yeah, he... Yeah, he wanted something to be exactly the way he wanted it to be, you know. If he didn't think it went the way he wanted it, he'd stop right in the middle of it. Instead of letting the thing finish, you know, he'd stop right in the middle. It might be a real good take. Hey, wait a minute, hey, hey, hey, hey, you know, that kind of thing, you know. Because we... He made the song, If I Had My Life to Live Over. I remember we was up in New York when he made that. Some Caucasian kind of heavy guy…
